newsitem.title: USA: Actor Jan-Michael Vincent denies drunk driving.
newsitem.headline: Actor Jan-Michael Vincent denies drunk driving.

text.p: Actor Jan-Michael Vincent, best known for his role in the television series "Airwolf", pleaded not guilty Tuesday to drunk driving charges stemming from a crash in which he broke his neck.

The 51-year-old actor was not in court in Laguna Niguel, some 50 miles (80 km) south of Los Angeles and the pleas to misdemeanor drunken driving and driving with a suspended license were entered on his behalf by an attorney.
Municipal Court Judge Ronald Kreber scheduled a Jan. 17 pretrial hearing and a Feb. 11 trial.

Vincent's attorney David Kupfer told reporters afterwards that the actor, who broke a vertebra in the Aug. 26 accident but was not paralysed, was doing well, but he declined to elaborate on his condition.

Police said at the time that Vincent was apparently following his girlfriend's car near Mission Viejo when his own vehicle struck the rear of hers, spun out of control and hit a traffic signal. They said his blood-alcohol level at the time of the accident was .18 percent -- more than twice the legal limit.
"Airwolf", which featured Vincent as the pilot of a high-tech attack helicopter on secret missions, ran on CBS from 1984 to 1986.
